senses.gloss: ch. (= h. צוּק) to be narrow, pressed.—Perf. עָק; part. עָק, עָיֵיק, (עִיִק) עָיק.
units: Targ. Is. XLIX, 20.—Trnsf. to feel pain, disgust; to be sick of.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:16">Targ. Jud. XVI, 16</cite> (h. text <he>קצר</he>).
Targ. O. Gen. XXVII, 46 (Y. Ithpe.; h. text קצתי); a. fr.—V. עָיְקָא.—ע׳ ל־ = (h. צר ל־) to be in distress, fear, anxiety.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 31:10">Targ. Ps. XXXI, 10</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="P00650"><he>עִיק</he></cite> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="P00555"><he>עַיִק</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00651"><he>עֲיַק</he></cite> noun); v. <cite ref="P00651"><he>עֲיָק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 23:9">Targ. Ex. XXIII, 9</cite> (h. text <cite ref="L00370"><he>לחץ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:16">Targ. Jud. XVI, 16</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot. <he>חד שינא מעיקא לי</he> one tooth annoys me.

Gen. R. s. 14 [read:] לא … עקתיה אלא דאתית לאָעָקָא ליה has this man (I) not enough trouble that thou camest to trouble him?; Midr. Till. to Ps. II אלא אף את אתי לאעקא ליה (read: אתית); Yalk. ib. 621 אלא דאת מעיקא ליה (read: מְעִיקַת). Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ top למחר … ואינון מְעִיקִין לון to-morrow they will be with us, and they trouble us (by treading upon our graves); a. e.—Part. pass. מְעִיק troubled, feeling dread.
